name: GitHub
author: DigitalPals
description: A GitHub Inbox in your menubar: running workflows, failed and action-required runs, directed notifications, and pushes, pull requests, issues, releases and discussions in your recent and watched repositories. Browse repositories and their latest commits. Read-only; uses the signed-in gh CLI.

barWidget.description: GitHub Inbox, repositories and commits through the gh CLI, with a live workflow marker and a pending-Inbox badge.

schema.label: Badge
schema.description: How the bar shows pending Inbox items: a coloured dot on the mark, a count, or nothing. Red is failures, amber other attention, accent general updates. The running-workflow marker shows either way.

schema.label: Recent account repos
schema.description: How many of your most recently pushed account and org repositories the Inbox follows. Watched repositories are added on top.

schema.label: Repo refresh (minutes)
schema.description: Also how often quiet repos' workflow runs are read; busy ones every minute.

schema.label: CI reports
schema.description: Workflow rows in the Inbox for recent and watched repositories.

schema.label: Toasts
schema.description: Notifications for pushes to watched repositories and failed or action-required workflows.
